HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 19.04.2023 CRL.M.A. 10321/2023 Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions. W.P.(CRL) 1092/2023 1.

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.187/2020 registered at PS Khyala under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on ground of settlement between the parties dated 22nd February, 2022 arrived at with the facilitation of the Mediation Centre, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi.

entities.text: Mediation Centre, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The said settlement is on record of this Court.
Petitioner No.1 is present in Court and petitioner Nos.2-4 as well as respondent No.2/complainant are present through VC and identified by the counsels and the IO.
The respondent No.2 states that she has received the amounts stated in the settlement and no further amounts are to be paid.
The petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 were married on 16th January, 2019.
No child was born out of their wedlock.
Due to differences between the parties, the marriage has resulted in a divorce dated 20th February, 2023.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioners states that the name of petitioner No.1 i.e. "Harsh Jassal"
has been wrongly recorded in the FIR as "Harshpreet Singh".
This may be accordingly noted by all parties concerned.

3. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.187/2020 registered at PS Khyala under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
4. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
